page_title: PyCharm: The Python IDE for you and your agents

sources.entry: PyCharm - Powerful Python IDE, which has professional version and community version.

summary.name: PyCharm
summary.one_liner: PyCharm is JetBrains' Python IDE, offered as a free Community-style core edition and a paid Pro subscription, with features for running AI agents alongside Python, web, data, and ML development.
use_cases: Writing and debugging Python web apps with Django, Flask, or FastAPI
Running and editing Jupyter notebooks for data analysis
Querying databases with SQL cells in notebooks
Refactoring and analyzing usages across a Python project
Running multiple AI coding agents against one codebase
Remote Python development over SSH, WSL, or Docker
summary.what_it_does: PyCharm parses Python code and resolves usages, types, and dependencies across a project, including virtual environments. It provides project-wide refactoring, usage analysis, and change previews. Debugging, testing, profiling, and database tools are built in. Jupyter notebooks can include SQL cells that save results to a dataframe, and notebooks can be converted to scripts. The page also describes a built-in MCP server that lets AI agents work with the IDE and a live Jupyter kernel, plus tracking of multiple agent sessions.
notable: Core features free forever for commercial and non-commercial use, with PyCharm Pro as a paid subscription
Free Pro access for students and educators; 30-day Pro trial with each major release
Built-in MCP server and bundled skills so AI agents get project-aware context
Pro adds Django/Flask/FastAPI support, full Jupyter notebooks, remote development, and database tools for 40+ databases
caveats: Advanced framework support, full notebook support, remote development, and database tools require PyCharm Pro, a paid subscription
AI agent features depend on a JetBrains AI subscription, your own API key, or an existing agent plan
Platforms named on the page are limited to Docker and WSL mentions; OS support beyond that is not explicitly listed in the page text
